source: Swahili Proverbs (Methali za Kiswahili), University of Illinois — Ambition section. Numbers are the source's entry numbers. Translations and meanings below are our own wording. Entries with ids starting 'k' come from the team's own methali list (list numbers kept); spellings standardised, meanings written by us.
notes: Each question hides the 'blank' word. 'options' always contains the correct answer first; shuffle in the app. 'min_age' lets onboarding age filter content.

questions.translation_en: Always forward.
questions.meaning_sw: Usirudi nyuma; endelea kusonga mbele.
questions.meaning_en: Keep moving ahead, never backward.

questions.translation_en: Try and you will see.
questions.meaning_sw: Huwezi kujua matokeo bila kujaribu.
questions.meaning_en: You only find out by trying.

questions.translation_en: Every beginning is heavy.
questions.meaning_sw: Kuanza jambo jipya huwa kugumu, lakini usikate tamaa.
questions.meaning_en: Starting anything is hard; push through it.

questions.translation_en: Whoever strives, benefits.
questions.meaning_sw: Juhudi huleta faida.
questions.meaning_en: Effort pays off.

questions.translation_en: Whatever you do, do it well.
questions.meaning_sw: Fanya kazi yako kwa ubora, hata kama ni ndogo.
questions.meaning_en: Put quality into everything you do.

questions.translation_en: Hope until the end.
questions.meaning_sw: Usipoteze matumaini mpaka jambo liishe.
questions.meaning_en: Stay confident all the way to the finish.

questions.text: Atakaye kufuga ng'ombe aanze na kuku.
questions.translation_en: Whoever wants to keep cattle should start with chickens.
questions.meaning_sw: Anza kidogo kabla ya kufikia makubwa.
questions.meaning_en: Don't look down on small beginnings.

questions.translation_en: Whoever wants what is under the bed must bend down.
questions.meaning_sw: Vitu vizuri havipatikani kirahisi; lazima ujitahidi.
questions.meaning_en: Good things take effort to get.

questions.translation_en: Whoever wants what is far away walks to it.
questions.meaning_sw: Ukitaka kitu kilicho mbali, fanya kila juhudi kukifikia.
questions.meaning_en: Distant goals need you to go after them.

questions.translation_en: You can't know what you can do until you've tried.
questions.meaning_sw: Uwezo wako hujulikana unapojaribu.
questions.meaning_en: You discover your ability by attempting things.

questions.text: Kila ndege huruka kwa bawa lake.
questions.translation_en: Every bird flies with its own wing.
questions.meaning_sw: Kila mtu hufanya kulingana na uwezo wake.
questions.meaning_en: Everyone works within their own strengths.

questions.translation_en: A hunter isn't afraid of thorns.
questions.meaning_sw: Anayetaka kufanikiwa hapaswi kuogopa magumu.
questions.meaning_en: If you want success, don't fear the hard parts.

questions.translation_en: A tailor doesn't choose the cloth.
questions.meaning_sw: Fanya kazi na kile ulicho nacho.
questions.meaning_en: Work with what you're given.

questions.translation_en: Aiming is not hitting.
questions.meaning_sw: Kupanga si sawa na kufanikiwa; usishangilie mapema.
questions.meaning_en: A plan isn't a result. Don't celebrate too early.

questions.translation_en: The ocean isn't crossed by swimming.
questions.meaning_sw: Kazi kubwa inahitaji njia na vifaa sahihi.
questions.meaning_en: Big goals need the right means, not just effort.

questions.translation_en: If a hut is too much for you, build a shack.
questions.meaning_sw: Ukishindwa jambo kubwa, anza na dogo unaloliweza.
questions.meaning_en: Scale down to what you can manage.

questions.translation_en: Stretch your legs to the length of your bed.
questions.meaning_sw: Tumia kulingana na uwezo wako.
questions.meaning_en: Live within your means.

questions.translation_en: Hardship at the start, joy at the end.
questions.meaning_sw: Mwisho mzuri huja baada ya juhudi ngumu.
questions.meaning_en: A happy ending follows the hard work.

questions.text: Usipokubali kutia mguu majini hutavuka kijito.
questions.translation_en: If you won't put your foot in the water, you won't cross the stream.
questions.meaning_sw: Lazima ukubali gharama ndogo ili ufike unakokwenda.
questions.meaning_en: You have to get your feet wet to get across.

questions.translation_en: The bone that beat the hyena, can a dog manage it?
questions.meaning_sw: Kama mwenye nguvu ameshindwa, mdhaifu atawezaje?
questions.meaning_en: If the strong couldn't do it, how will the weaker?

questions.translation_en: An arrow without feathers won't go far.
questions.meaning_sw: Vitu vidogo vinaweza kuwa muhimu kwa mafanikio.
questions.meaning_en: Small details can make or break success.

questions.text: Kelele za chura hazimkatazi ng'ombe kunywa maji.
questions.prompt: Kelele za chura hazimkatazi ng'ombe kunywa ___.
questions.translation_en: The frog's noise doesn't stop the cow from drinking.
questions.meaning_sw: Usiache kazi yako kwa sababu ya maneno ya watu.
questions.meaning_en: Don't let others' noise stop you.

questions.translation_en: The far traveller passes the mountain.
questions.meaning_sw: Mwenye nia ya kufika mbali hushinda vikwazo.
questions.meaning_en: Determination carries you past obstacles.

questions.text: Ukioka samaki, huwezi kuondoa manyoya ya kuku.
questions.prompt: Ukioka samaki, huwezi kuondoa manyoya ya ___.
questions.translation_en: While baking fish, you can't pluck a chicken.
questions.meaning_sw: Fanya jambo moja kwa wakati mmoja.
questions.meaning_en: Do one thing at a time.

questions.translation_en: Hurry, hurry has no blessing.
questions.meaning_sw: Ukifanya mambo kwa pupa, mara nyingi hayaendi vizuri.
questions.meaning_en: Rushing usually spoils things.

questions.translation_en: Anger brings loss.
questions.meaning_sw: Ukitenda jambo ukiwa na hasira, mwishowe unapata hasara.
questions.meaning_en: Acting in anger ends up costing you.

questions.translation_en: Savings don't rot.
questions.meaning_sw: Kuweka akiba ni busara; itakusaidia siku ya shida.
questions.meaning_en: Saving is wise; it helps you on a hard day.

questions.translation_en: Intelligence is wealth.
questions.meaning_sw: Akili na maarifa ni utajiri ambao hakuna anayeweza kukunyang'anya.
questions.meaning_en: Knowledge is wealth nobody can take from you.

questions.translation_en: The one who helps you in hardship is your friend.
questions.meaning_sw: Rafiki wa kweli hujulikana wakati wa shida.
questions.meaning_en: A true friend shows up in hard times.

questions.translation_en: Who doesn't heed elders breaks a leg.
questions.meaning_sw: Asiyesikiliza ushauri wa wakubwa hupata matatizo.
questions.meaning_en: Ignore your elders' advice and you get into trouble.

questions.translation_en: One finger can't crush a louse.
questions.meaning_sw: Umoja ni nguvu; mtu mmoja peke yake hawezi mengi.
questions.meaning_en: Unity is strength; one person alone can't do much.

questions.translation_en: One hand can't raise a child.
questions.meaning_sw: Kazi kubwa inahitaji ushirikiano wa watu wengi.
questions.meaning_en: Big tasks need many people working together.

questions.translation_en: Be late, but arrive.
questions.meaning_sw: Ni bora kuchelewa lakini ufike salama kuliko kukimbilia hatari.
questions.meaning_en: Better late and safe than rushing into danger.

questions.translation_en: Spilled water can't be scooped up.
questions.meaning_sw: Jambo likishaharibika halirudi kama zamani; fikiri kabla ya kutenda.
questions.meaning_en: Some mistakes can't be undone; think before you act.

questions.translation_en: Who is like a mother?
questions.meaning_sw: Hakuna anayeweza kuchukua nafasi ya mama.
questions.meaning_en: Nobody can take a mother's place.

questions.translation_en: Who walks slowly doesn't stumble.
questions.meaning_sw: Anayefanya mambo kwa utulivu huepuka makosa.
questions.meaning_en: Doing things calmly helps you avoid mistakes.

questions.translation_en: Who runs stubs a toe.
questions.meaning_sw: Ukikimbilia mambo, utafanya makosa.
questions.meaning_en: Rush things and you'll slip up.

questions.translation_en: A lion's cub is a lion.
questions.meaning_sw: Mtoto mara nyingi hufanana na wazazi wake kwa tabia na uwezo.
questions.meaning_en: Children often take after their parents.

questions.translation_en: Who doesn't ask has nothing to learn.
questions.meaning_sw: Kuuliza maswali ndiyo njia ya kujifunza.
questions.meaning_en: Asking questions is how you learn.

questions.translation_en: Who follows the bees won't miss the honey.
questions.meaning_sw: Ukifuata njia sahihi au watu wema, utanufaika.
questions.meaning_en: Follow the right path or people and you'll benefit.

questions.translation_en: A good name shines in the dark.
questions.meaning_sw: Sifa nzuri hujulikana hata mahali usipokuwepo.
questions.meaning_en: A good reputation is known even where you aren't.

questions.translation_en: Hearing is not seeing.
questions.meaning_sw: Usiamini kila unachosikia mpaka ujionee mwenyewe.
questions.meaning_en: Don't believe everything you hear until you see it.

questions.translation_en: Who won't accept defeat is no true competitor.
questions.meaning_sw: Mshindani wa kweli hukubali matokeo, akishinda au akishindwa.
questions.meaning_en: A real competitor accepts the result, win or lose.

questions.translation_en: Every door has its own key.
questions.meaning_sw: Kila tatizo lina suluhisho lake.
questions.meaning_en: Every problem has its own solution.

questions.translation_en: Getting lost is how you learn the way.
questions.meaning_sw: Makosa hutufundisha; kupitia kwake tunajifunza.
questions.meaning_en: Mistakes are how we learn.

questions.translation_en: Eyes have no curtain.
questions.meaning_sw: Macho huona kila kilicho mbele yake; huwezi kuyazuia kuona.
questions.meaning_en: Eyes see whatever is in front of them.

questions.translation_en: Today it's you, tomorrow it's your neighbour.
questions.meaning_sw: Mambo hubadilika; usimcheke mwenye shida, kesho inaweza kuwa zamu yako.
questions.meaning_en: Don't mock someone's trouble; tomorrow it could be yours.

questions.translation_en: Guest, come, so the host may prosper.
questions.meaning_sw: Mgeni huleta neema; mwenyeji hufaidika kwa kumkaribisha.
questions.meaning_en: Guests bring blessings to the home that welcomes them.

questions.translation_en: The patient one eats ripe fruit.
questions.meaning_sw: Anayesubiri kwa uvumilivu hupata kilicho bora.
questions.meaning_en: Patience is rewarded with the best.

questions.translation_en: Who wants everything loses everything.
questions.meaning_sw: Tamaa ya kupata kila kitu inaweza kukufanya ukose vyote.
questions.meaning_en: Greed for everything can leave you with nothing.

questions.translation_en: As you raise a child, so it grows.
questions.meaning_sw: Malezi ya mtoto ndiyo humfanya awe mtu wa aina fulani.
questions.meaning_en: How you raise a child shapes who they become.

questions.translation_en: A good thing sells itself; a bad thing hawks itself around.
questions.meaning_sw: Kitu bora hakihitaji kutangazwa sana; kibaya ndicho hutafuta wateja.
questions.meaning_en: Quality speaks for itself; poor goods need pushing.

questions.text: Kutoa ni moyo, usambe ni utajiri.
questions.translation_en: Giving comes from the heart, not from wealth.
questions.meaning_sw: Ukarimu hautegemei wingi wa mali bali moyo wa mtu.
questions.meaning_en: Generosity depends on the heart, not on riches.

questions.translation_en: Regret is a grandchild.
questions.meaning_sw: Majuto huja mwishoni, baada ya kosa kufanyika.
questions.meaning_en: Regret always comes last, after the mistake.

questions.translation_en: Water you haven't entered, you don't know its depth.
questions.meaning_sw: Usidharau jambo ambalo hujalijaribu.
questions.meaning_en: Don't judge something you haven't tried.

questions.translation_en: A rope breaks at its weak spot.
questions.meaning_sw: Matatizo hutokea mahali palipo na udhaifu.
questions.meaning_en: Things fail where they are weakest.

questions.translation_en: Kind words draw a snake out of its hole.
questions.meaning_sw: Lugha nzuri hufanikisha hata mambo magumu.
questions.meaning_en: Kind words can achieve even hard things.

questions.translation_en: Who earns in the sun eats in the shade.
questions.meaning_sw: Anayefanya kazi kwa bidii leo atapumzika baadaye.
questions.meaning_en: Work hard now and rest later.

questions.translation_en: A healer can't heal himself.
questions.meaning_sw: Anayewasaidia wengine mara nyingi hawezi kujisaidia mwenyewe.
questions.meaning_en: Those who help others often can't help themselves.

questions.translation_en: Who climbs a ladder comes down.
questions.meaning_sw: Aliye juu leo anaweza kushuka kesho; usijivune.
questions.meaning_en: Whoever is up today may come down tomorrow; stay humble.

questions.translation_en: One with eyes isn't told 'look'.
questions.meaning_sw: Mtu mwenye akili hujionea mwenyewe bila kuambiwa.
questions.meaning_en: A sensible person sees for themselves.

questions.translation_en: The drum that booms loudest doesn't last.
questions.meaning_sw: Jambo linalovuma sana mara nyingi huisha haraka.
questions.meaning_en: What is loudest often fades fastest.

questions.translation_en: The village rooster doesn't crow in town.
questions.meaning_sw: Mtu hana sauti wala mamlaka mahali pa ugenini.
questions.meaning_en: Away from home, your voice carries less weight.

questions.translation_en: Going first is not arriving.
questions.meaning_sw: Kuanza mapema hakuhakikishi kumaliza; endelea kujitahidi.
questions.meaning_en: Starting first doesn't mean finishing first.

questions.text: Heri kujikwaa kidole kuliko kujikwaa ulimi.
questions.translation_en: Better to stub your toe than your tongue.
questions.meaning_sw: Ni bora kuumia mwili kuliko kusema maneno mabaya.
questions.meaning_en: Better a hurt toe than hurtful words.

questions.translation_en: What's past is no illness; let's tend to what's coming.
questions.meaning_sw: Usihangaike na yaliyopita; jiandae kwa yajayo.
questions.meaning_en: Don't dwell on the past; prepare for the future.

questions.text: Nia njema ni tabibu, nia mbaya huharibu.
questions.prompt: Nia njema ni ___, nia mbaya huharibu.
questions.translation_en: Good intentions heal; bad intentions destroy.
questions.meaning_sw: Moyo mwema huponya, moyo mbaya huharibu.
questions.meaning_en: Good intentions heal; bad ones ruin.

questions.translation_en: Harsh words don't break bones.
questions.meaning_sw: Maneno ya kejeli hayakudhuru mwili; usiyatilie maanani.
questions.meaning_en: Harsh words can't break your bones; don't let them stop you.

questions.translation_en: Wait below for the one who is up high.
questions.meaning_sw: Aliye na cheo leo atashuka siku moja; usimwonee wivu.
questions.meaning_en: Those on top today come down one day.

questions.text: Mpiga ngumi ukuta huumiza mkono wake.
questions.translation_en: Who punches a wall hurts his own hand.
questions.meaning_sw: Ukipambana na kisichowezekana, unajiumiza mwenyewe.
questions.meaning_en: Fighting the impossible only hurts you.

questions.translation_en: Who digs a well falls in himself.
questions.meaning_sw: Anayemtegea mwenzake mabaya, mabaya humrudia yeye.
questions.meaning_en: Plot harm for others and it comes back to you.

questions.translation_en: Every dog barks at its own door.
questions.meaning_sw: Kila mtu ni jasiri akiwa nyumbani kwake.
questions.meaning_en: Everyone is brave on home ground.

questions.text: Asiyefunzwa na mamaye hufunzwa na ulimwengu.
questions.translation_en: Who isn't taught by their mother is taught by the world.
questions.meaning_sw: Asiyepata malezi mema nyumbani hujifunza kwa magumu ya maisha.
questions.meaning_en: Without good upbringing, life teaches you the hard way.

questions.translation_en: The knife has reached the bone.
questions.meaning_sw: Hali imekuwa ngumu kupita kiasi; uvumilivu umeisha.
questions.meaning_en: Things have become unbearable.

questions.translation_en: A big pot is never without crust.
questions.meaning_sw: Mtu mzima au mwenye uzoefu huwa na kitu cha kusaidia daima.
questions.meaning_en: Elders always have something to offer.

questions.translation_en: Two bulls can't share one pen.
questions.meaning_sw: Viongozi wawili wenye nguvu sawa hawawezi kuongoza pamoja kwa amani.
questions.meaning_en: Two strong leaders can't share one place.

questions.translation_en: With many captains, the ship goes off course.
questions.meaning_sw: Watu wengi wakiongoza jambo moja bila mpangilio, huharibika.
questions.meaning_en: Too many leaders spoil the job.

questions.translation_en: A race on the rooftop ends at the edge.
questions.meaning_sw: Kila jambo lina mwisho wake; ujanja haudumu milele.
questions.meaning_en: Everything has its limit.

questions.text: Mbiu ya mgambo ikilia kuna jambo.
questions.translation_en: When the village horn sounds, something is up.
questions.meaning_sw: Taarifa rasmi ikitolewa, kuna jambo muhimu la kusikiliza.
questions.meaning_en: When an official call goes out, pay attention.

questions.translation_en: A trap without bait catches nothing.
questions.meaning_sw: Ukitaka kupata kitu, lazima uweke juhudi au kivutio.
questions.meaning_en: To get something, you have to put something in.

questions.translation_en: A hungry person has no taboos.
questions.meaning_sw: Mtu mwenye shida kubwa hachagui; hupokea kinachopatikana.
questions.meaning_en: Someone in great need can't be choosy.

questions.text: Mzigo wa mwenzio ni kanda la usufi.
questions.prompt: Mzigo wa mwenzio ni kanda la ___.
questions.translation_en: Your neighbour's load is a bag of kapok.
questions.meaning_sw: Shida ya mwenzako huonekana nyepesi kwa sababu si wewe unayeibeba.
questions.meaning_en: Other people's burdens always look light.

questions.translation_en: Who rides two horses at once splits apart.
questions.meaning_sw: Ukijaribu kufanya mambo mawili makubwa kwa wakati mmoja, utashindwa.
questions.meaning_en: Try to do two big things at once and you'll fail at both.

questions.translation_en: Who boasts about drinking the water never drinks it.
questions.meaning_sw: Anayejigamba sana kuhusu jambo mara nyingi hulifanikishi.
questions.meaning_en: Those who boast loudest often don't deliver.

questions.translation_en: An empty hand isn't licked.
questions.meaning_sw: Bila kuwa na kitu cha kutoa, ni vigumu kupata msaada.
questions.meaning_en: Empty-handed, it's hard to get anything back.

questions.translation_en: Who fears the child crying will cry himself.
questions.meaning_sw: Mzazi asiyemrekebisha mtoto kwa kuogopa kumliza ataumia baadaye.
questions.meaning_en: A parent who never corrects a child will suffer later.

excluded_from_source.reason: Adult themes or crude wording; keep out of the general pool until an 18+ content tier exists.
